items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Advanced degree in related area.
6 - 10 years of related experience.
Experience with admissions, continuing education, student services, or advancement business processes.
6 or more years of business systems analysis and Salesforce configuration experience in a production environment.
Experience in a University of California setting or comparable public higher education environment.
Experience serving as the senior or lead Salesforce functional resource for an organization, including advising business stakeholders on solution options and trade-offs.
Direct experience with TargetX/Liaison, ASCEND/UC Innovation, Salesforce Education Cloud, or Marketing Cloud/Account Engagement.
Experience supporting multiple Salesforce orgs, or a single org serving multiple independent business units with distinct data-sharing requirements.

Applies advanced business analysis concepts to identify, evaluate and define highly complex, systems scope and objectives based on advanced knowledge of applicable business practices, processes and systems and industry standards to meet end-user needs. Works at the highest technical level of various phases of systems analysis. Considers the business implications of applying technology to the current and future business environment. Serves as the campus subject matter expert for the Salesforce platform across Professional and Global Education, School of Business, and Development & Alumni Engagement instances. (25% time)

Initiates, designs or modifies highly complex systems and procedures where standardized policies or procedures may or may not exist. Creates highly technical specifications for systems with broad impact at a campus/medical center/OP or within a large organization. Develops unit integration and acceptance testing plans and scenarios. May lead cross-functional teams to address complex business or systems issues. Performs advanced declarative Salesforce configuration including data model, Flow, page layouts, reports and dashboards, and defines the business rules, data requirements and end-user experience required of Salesforce integrations with Banner, Slate and campus identity services. Supports platform transitions and consolidation affecting campus Salesforce instances, including current-state process analysis, data mapping requirements, and user acceptance testing. (20% time)

Serves as ongoing liaison between Information Technology Solutions and Professional and Global Education, the School of Business, and Development & Alumni Engagement, and to the staff who manage or administer each Salesforce instance. Establishes and facilitates a campus Salesforce community of practice. Coordinates shared practices, terminology and reusable solutions across instances, surfaces and helps reconcile competing requirements between units, and supports IT governance in prioritizing cross-unit Salesforce work. (20% time)

Initiates, facilitates, implements and documents work process changes. Prepares and approves or obtains approval for business process and procedural documentation. Initiates and oversees changes in processes and procedures. Sets the technical requirements for complex specifications. Documents and maintains change control practices for business-facing Salesforce configuration across the three instances. (10% time)

Supports Professional and Global Education, the School of Business, and Development & Alumni Engagement in applying established data governance practices to their use of Salesforce, including data definitions, data quality expectations, record ownership, and reconciliation of person records across prospect, student, alumni and donor populations. Analyzes business roles and data classification to document the access each role requires, and confirms that Salesforce configuration and data handling follow established ITS policies and procedures and applicable state and federal regulations including UC Electronic Information Security Policy (IS-3), UC privacy policy and FERPA. Supports risk assessments, vendor security reviews and audit response. (10% time)

Serves as functional point of contact for Salesforce and campus platform partners. Reviews statements of work, functional requirements and vendor deliverables for fit with business need and adherence to campus standards. Provides business analysis supporting contract renewal, license optimization and procurement in coordination with ITS and Procurement. (10% time)

Performs highly complex analysis of business and user needs, documentation of requirements and translation into proper system and process requirement specifications. Provides advanced support and training on new applications. Mentors experienced Business Systems Analysts. Delivers training and knowledge transfer to unit Salesforce administrators and end users. (5% time)

Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills. Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization. Interpersonal and communication skills to work with both technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization.
Familiarity with Apex, Lightning Web Components and Salesforce APIs sufficient to evaluate build-versus-configure options and communicate effectively with developers.
Demonstrated ability to work with others from diverse backgrounds.
Working knowledge of Ellucian Banner, Technolutions Slate, or comparable student information and CRM systems.
Demonstrated testing and test planning skills.
Familiarity with Salesforce release cycles sufficient to plan business readiness, communications and user acceptance testing.
Knowledge relating to the design of processes and software across the organization.
Experience supporting a CRM or student system platform migration or consolidation, including current-state analysis, requirements definition, and data mapping.
Understanding and skill in complex process and systems requirement documentation standards, such as Use Case modeling, User Story creations and narrative description.
Self-motivated and works independently and as part of a team. Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines. Demonstrates problem solving skills.
Demonstrated skills needed to develop process and system implementation plans.
Advanced knowledge of business processes and procedures.
Advanced knowledge of business and process analysis functions.
Advanced knowledge of related areas of IT.

Demonstrated experience with process analysis, systems analysis, process architectures and systems analysis methodologies and practices including traditional waterfall, Agile, Agile Scrum, UML, UML Enterprise, etc.
Advanced skills and methodologies associated with process and software design, modification and implementation.
Experience working in an education setting, such as K–12, higher education, or lifelong learning and continuing education.
Advanced knowledge of Salesforce declarative configuration, including Flow, data model design, page layout and Lightning experience customization, and reporting.

Working knowledge of Salesforce data architecture and data management concepts, including data quality, deduplication, record matching, and the relationship between Salesforce and institutional systems of record.

Working knowledge of established ITS policies and procedures and applicable state and federal regulations, including UC Electronic Information Security Policy (IS-3), UC privacy policy and FERPA, and demonstrated ability to analyze and document data access and data handling requirements consistent with them.
Demonstrated ability to serve as liaison across organizationally independent business units, building consensus and setting functional direction without formal authority.
